name: levl-reel
description: Levl reels and posts made in code with Remotion. Separate from the app.

scripts.sound: node sfx.mjs comeback && node sfx.mjs boss
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Comeback out/levl-comeback.mp4 --crf=20 --browser-executable=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell && remotion render src/index.ts BossFight out/levl-boss.mp4 --crf=20 --browser-executable=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell
scripts.posts: for id in SplitCover SplitDays SplitXp ComebackPost; do remotion still src/index.ts $id out/post-$id.png --browser-executable=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell; done
